L268@P3: results were obtained with the murine and the human
L269@P3: transfected ceils. These observations demonstrate that the
L270@P3: novel receptor is highly selective for IPI0 and Mig, and we
L271@P3: propose to name it IP10/Mig receptor (IPl0/MigR.). As
L272@P3: shown in Fig. 2, repeated stimulation with IP10 or Mig resuited in desensitization as commonly observed for chemokine receptors. Furthermore, cross-desensitization occurred
L273@P3: when the cells were stimulated with IPl0 followed by Mig
L274@P3: or vice versa, confirming that the receptor has high affinity
L275@P3: for both chemokines. At 100 nM concentration, it became
L276@P3: evident that Mig was more potent in cross-desensitization
L277@P3: than IP10, suggesting higher affinity or binding stability of
L278@P3: IP10/MigR for Mig.
L279@P3: Transfected cells expressing the IP10/MigR readily migrated toward IP10 and Mig while the non-transfected, parental cells did not respond (Fig. 2). Both agonists showed a
L280@P3: typically biphasic concentration dependence. IP10 induced
L281@P3: migration at concentrations above 1 nM whereas the response of Mig became detectable above 10 nM. The efficacy, which is measured by the maximum number of migrating cells, was about twice as high for Mig than for IPl0.
L282@P3: These results demonstrate that the IP10/MigP,., like all
L283@P3: known chemokine receptors in leukocytes, signals for locomotion.

L320@P4: Expression in Aaivated T-LymphocHes. In view of the
L321@P4: observed chemokine selectivity it was of interest to examine the occurrence of the IP10/MigR in leukocytes and related cell lines. As shown in Fig. 3, abundant expression of
L322@P4: mRNA of the expected size was found in the cloned
L323@P4: CD4 + T cells, KT30, that were used for isolation of the receptor cDNA. Similar levels of expression were observed
L324@P4: in the CD8 + T cell clone, ERCD8, and the NK cell clone,
L325@P4: ERNK57. In freshly isolated blood lymphocytes and nylon
L326@P4: wool-purified T cells, by contrast, IP10/MigR transcripts
L327@P4: were barely detectable. However, when these cells were
L328@P4: cultured in the presence of IL-2, a strong upregulation was
L329@P4: obtained, and the level of receptor mRNA approached that
L330@P4: ofT and NK cell clones. No IP10/MigR transcripts were
L331@P4: found in freshly isolated blood monocytes, neutrophil leukocytes, eosinophil leukocytes. Additional leukocyte-related
L332@P4: cells that did not express IP10/MigR mRNA include the
L333@P4: mast cell line, HMC-1, the promyelocytic leukemia line,
L334@P4: HL60, the histiocytic lymphoma, U937, the chronic myelogeneous leukemia line, K562, the acute T cell leukemia line,
L335@P4: Jurkat, the acute lymphoblastic leukemia line, Molt, the
L336@P4: B-lymphoblastic cell lines Daudi and Raft, lymphocytes
L337@P4: from patients with chronic and acute B-lymphoid leukemia
L338@P4: (B-CLL and B-ALL), mature basophils from a patient with
L339@P4: basophilic leukemia, and the erythroleukemia cell line,
L340@P4: HEL. By contrast, the receptors for chemokines which
L341@P4: have been shown previously to attract lymphocytes, i.e.
L342@P4: MCP-1, MCP-2, MCP-3, MIP-le~, MIP-1[3 and
L343@P4: RANTES (29, 43-46), are also found in monocytes and
L344@P4: granulocytes. Therefore, the exclusive expression of IP10/
L345@P4: MigR in activated T-lymphocytes is an exciting finding
L346@P4: and suggests that this novel receptor may mediate selective
L347@P4: lymphocyte recruitment.
L348@P4: Responses of Human T-Lymphocytes. In agreement with
L349@P4: the cellular distribution of the IP10/MigR, we found that
L350@P4: activated human T-lymphocytes are highly responsive to
L351@P4: IP10 and Mig (Fig. 4). The activity of IP10 and Mig as inducers of [Ca2+]i changes and in vitro chemotaxis was consistent with the effects observed in the transfected cells expressing the IP10/MigR as IP10 was more potent but less
L352@P4: efficacious than Mig. Activation of the T-lymphocytes by
L353@P4: culturing in the presence of IL-2 was required, and no response was observed with freshly isolated blood lymphocytes.
